extractor_notes: Only one event is listed for a feature film, and the description gives no runtime, so there is no way to tell whether the event list is complete or a single excerpt; a feature with a BBFC 15 certificate and one listed event is itself a finding. The single timecode is recorded as elapsed because no transmission time is given and 00:48:10 reads as a position within a feature. The event is split into two observations: the depicted sexual intercourse (sexual_content, is_depicted true) and the explicit absence of nudity (nudity, is_depicted false), because the description makes a positive statement about nudity that a classifier may need and that would be lost if merged. 'Played for comedy', 'broad and unrealistic' and 'scored for laughs' are the source's own framing words, so treatment is recorded as comedic; the source separately states intercourse is 'clearly depicted', so is_depicted is true for the sexual content - the comedic framing does not displace the depiction. 'COUNTRIES: UK, FR' names two territories; only a BBFC (UK) certificate is given and no French certificate is mentioned. No transmission time at all is stated, so nothing in this description can be checked against any time-of-day condition.
